atoms.b: A ((++connotation definition)) is an idea or a feeling that a word or phrase creates for an individual.
A ((++definition connotation)) is the exact meaning of a word.

instruction.text: Read the text and then answer the following questions.

atoms.text: Recently, there has been a lot of excited talk about the new ice cream van on George Street, which creates customised ice cream cones for their customers. I went along with high expectations, however, the cone that I received was a tad excessive to say the least. Personally, I prefer my ice cream as minimalistic as possible.

hint.text: Connotations can come in a positive, negative or neutral form. It’s important to know a word’s denotation (the standard definition) and connotation (the feelings associated with it) to fully understand it.
